preconditions.description: The length of the text n must be between 1 and 2,000,000.

preconditions.expression: len(text) == n and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in text)
preconditions.description: The text must consist of exactly n lower-case Latin letters.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of crossing subpalindrome pairs modulo 51123987.
